_comment: Maps logical Traffix names to actual SUMO IDs generated by Eclipse SUMO netconvert 1.28.0 from bazaar.nod.xml + bazaar.edg.xml. All IDs verified from bazaar.net.xml generated 2026-10-09.

edges._note_market: edge.market = main1 + main2 (passes through J2). Uninstrumented — no fixed detectors. Truth-only access.
edges._note_bypass: edge.bypass = byp1 + byp2 (passes through J3). Covered by det.bypass_mid detector.
edges._note_decision_edge: Delivery upstream diversion decision edge = 'in' (edge.entry). Reroute from 'in' only; main1 is too late.

tls.upstream._note: link indices 0-1 serve in->byp1; indices 2-3 serve in->main1. Single phase because both routes share the upstream junction.

tls.downstream._note: No all-red phase between groups in netconvert output. Yellow serves as brief clearance.

det.entry_count.note: Counts inbound flow on upstream approach.

det.upstream_queue.note: Loop detector covering approach queue near J1.

det.market_mid_TRUTH.note: Market road detector. TRUTH ONLY — must NOT be read by the observation gateway or the ML pipeline. Used only for scoring and simulation-view rendering.

det.bypass_mid.note: Bypass coverage detector — observational. Feeds the observation gateway.

routes._note_bypass_eligibility: Delivery vehicle may only accept bypass_route if its current edge is 'in' (edge.entry). After passing J1 onto main1, the offer must be rejected.

veh.role.rider.note: Urvashi — two-wheeler commuter on market road. Probe sharing toggled by phone.

veh.role.auto.note: Nandani — auto-rickshaw on market road. Reports waterlogging.

veh.role.delivery.note: Prakhyat — delivery van. Upstream of market. Offered bypass_route when evidence meets threshold. Decision edge = 'in'.

vehicle_class_restrictions._note: No explicit allow/disallow on edges in this minimal runnable version. All vClasses use both routes. Bypass offered only to veh.role.delivery via advisory. Future: restrict motorcycles from bypass via edge allow attribute.
